config.expression: coalesce({view.custom.alm.text}, "No active alarms on this machine")

transforms.code:
from java.lang import Throwable
	out = {"text": "No active alarms on this machine", "sub": "0 standing - 0 unacknowledged", "colour": "#8b98a3", "bg": "#1d232a", "border": "#2c343d", "time": "", "n": 0, "active": 0}
	try:
		rows = MachineDemo.plant.liveAlarms()
	except Throwable:
		return out
	if not rows:
		return out
	order = {"Diagnostic": 0, "Low": 1, "Medium": 2, "High": 3, "Critical": 4}
	best = None
	bestscore = -1
	bestpri = 0
	unacked = 0
	active = 0
	for a in rows:
		if not a.get("acked"):
			unacked = unacked + 1
		pri = order.get(str(a.get("priority") or "Low"), 1)
		if a.get("active"):
			active = active + 1
			score = 100 + pri * 2
		else:
			score = pri * 2
		if not a.get("acked"):
			score = score + 1
		if score > bestscore:
			bestscore = score
			bestpri = pri
			best = a
	if best is None:
		return out
	lbl = str(best.get("label") or "")
	nm = str(best.get("name") or "Alarm")
	if not lbl:
		lbl = nm
	st = str(best.get("state") or "")
	colour = "#6cc4e8"
	bg = "#1d232a"
	border = "#2c343d"
	if bestpri >= 3:
		colour = "#ff8d92"
		bg = "#2e1a1d"
		border = "#c2444c"
	elif bestpri == 2:
		colour = "#eebf5e"
		bg = "#2b2418"
		border = "#7d6427"
	if not best.get("active"):
		# Cleared is not the same as wrong. The background was already being
		# neutralised here but the TEXT stayed red, so a page with zero active
		# alarms still read as an emergency. A cleared alarm that nobody has
		# acknowledged is amber - it wants attention, not action - and one that
		# has been acknowledged is just history.
		bg = "#1d232a"
		border = "#2c343d"
		if best.get("acked"):
			colour = "#8b98a3"
		else:
			colour = "#eebf5e"
	out["text"] = lbl + "  -  " + st
	out["sub"] = "%d standing - %d active - %d unacknowledged" % (len(rows), active, unacked)
	out["colour"] = colour
	out["bg"] = bg
	out["border"] = border
	out["time"] = str(best.get("time") or "")
	out["n"] = len(rows)
	out["active"] = active
	return out
